desk:
**BLUF:** The community is focused on a reported Ukrainian cruise-missile strike on Russia’s Marinovka airbase and conflicting accounts of a senior U.S. Joint Staff officer’s dismissal. The single most important development is the Marinovka attack, with multiple posts confirming fires, destroyed Su-34s and glide-bomb implications.

## MAIN THREADS
### Ukrainian strike on Marinovka airbase
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115849515294978180) reports Ukraine’s Navy destroyed two Su-34s in an overnight cruise-missile strike; NASA FIRMS shows large flightline fire.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115849691434738051) adds follow-up imagery and notes the base’s role in glide-bomb attacks.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115849636938129528) links Ukrainian Navy statement confirming the strike.

### Dismissal of Lt Gen Brett Sylvia
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115818484235907461) cites The Atlantic on loss of confidence and friction with Elbridge Colby.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115818484235907461) also relays Fox News report of failed polygraphs and alleged leaks, noting the two accounts conflict.

### Suspected cyberattack on U.S. commissaries
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115792657548992533) reports Pentagon treating August freezer malfunctions at multiple bases as possible cyber incident, with Cyber Command involvement and French parallels.

### Black Sea maritime-drone attack
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115778702768287834) details three drones striking Liberian-flagged container ship off Bulgaria; vessel sank, hazardous cargo adrift, crew rescued.

### Russian diesel sanctions concerns
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115797749279166829) notes U.S. firms reportedly refusing Russian diesel cargoes over legality of Trump-era waiver.

## CONTESTED
Reasons for Lt Gen Sylvia’s removal: The Atlantic cites policy friction; Fox cites failed polygraphs and leaks. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115818484235907461) flags the discrepancy and single-source nature of the Fox account.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115797751594180807) — Washington Sun reporting on Russian diesel refusal (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115770668046225448) — Armenia parliament brawl details (unconfirmed beyond local media).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for further Ukrainian strikes on Russian airfields, official confirmation or charges in the Sylvia case, and any attribution or escalation in Black Sea drone attacks.
